purpose: Freeze a financially meaningful and causal contract-selection rule for a possible CU/RB domestic-night predictive experiment before the selection variable is bulk-used or any CSI1000 performance is read.
DCE_I_excluded: official authentication access remains blocked; it cannot enter this candidate family
financial_rationale: The relevant commodity price-discovery channel should use the contract that was demonstrably most actively traded by the end of the preceding mainland day session, rather than a hindsight continuous series or a mechanically nearest contract that may be illiquid near delivery.
selection_time: previous China trading day 15:00:00 Beijing time

eligible_contracts.data: pinned contract-level 5-minute SHFE transport data validated against official SHFE daily OHLC
eligible_contracts.required_previous_day_window: at least one observed bar during 09:00:00-14:55:00 on the previous China trading day
eligible_contracts.delivery_constraint: contract delivery month must not be earlier than the previous China calendar month

ranking_rule.primary: sum the selected contract's 5-minute bar volume only over previous China trading date 09:00:00-14:55:00; choose the largest cumulative volume
ranking_rule.reason: all included volume is observable by the A-share 15:00 close and represents which contract was the dominant price-discovery venue before the overnight interval begins

same_contract_requirement.if_selected_contract_has_no_valid_target: row unavailable; never switch to another target-night contract

required_volume_integrity_gate_before_bu.samples: the same six frozen SHFE_CU/RB source-validation contract-dates from domestic_night_source_crosscheck_sample_freeze.json
required_volume_integrity_gate_before_bu.measurement: sum the transport source 5-minute volume over the entire correctly assigned exchange trading day and compare with the already-fetched exact-contract SHFE official daily VOLUME
required_volume_integrity_gate_before_bu.reason: volume is integer trade quantity and is about to become a causal contract-selection input; exact daily reconciliation is required before using intraday volume ranking
required_volume_integrity_gate_before_bu.pass_rule: at least 2 of 3 frozen samples per product must reconcile exactly and no sample may show an unresolved systematic scaling or trading-day allocation mismatch
required_volume_integrity_gate_before_bu.if_fail: do not use the volume-ranking contract-selection family. A different selection rule would require a new result-free preregistration before any CSI1000 target metric is read.

future_feature_semantics_if_volume_gate_.start: last selected-contract 5-minute bar close at 14:55 on the previous China trading day, representing the bar ending at the 15:00 mainland close
future_feature_semantics_if_volume_gate_.end: last selected-contract night-session bar close belonging to the target exchange trading day under the frozen historical SHFE product clock
future_feature_semantics_if_volume_gate_.target_morning_commodity_session: excluded from this first domestic-night feature family to isolate information generated strictly in the night session
future_feature_semantics_if_volume_gate_.no_night_session: missing/unavailable, not zero and not forward-filled

data_boundary.raw_files_that_extend_beyond_2020: a later bulk extractor may stream chronologically and must stop before decoding any post-2020 OHLCV fields; zero post-2020 market rows may be materialized or used
